headline.caveat: Prices undisclosed. Agreements covering >2,600MW across Vistra's PJM nuclear fleet (the former Energy Harbor plants), incl. capacity uprates and support for adding new nuclear generation.

realized_to_date.caveat: Staggered starts across plants; cumulative payments not disclosed.

nature_md: A portfolio of long-term nuclear agreements announced Jan 9, 2026 between Meta and Vistra covering more than 2,600MW across Vistra's PJM nuclear fleet (Beaver Valley, Davis-Besse, Perry — acquired with Energy Harbor), including plant uprates and commitments that support adding new nuclear generation to the grid. Dollar terms and per-plant tenors are undisclosed. Together with Clinton (see related edge), Meta has contracted well over 3.7GW of nuclear capacity — the largest corporate nuclear offtake portfolio.

accounting.payer_treatment_md: Meta expenses power/attributes as delivered; long-dated commitments live in purchase-obligation footnotes, off balance sheet. No prepayment disclosed.
accounting.payee_treatment_md: Vistra layers contracted revenue over merchant PJM exposure from the agreed start dates and books uprate spending as growth capex de-risked by contracted offtake; revenue from COD/start of each tranche.

both_sides_md: **Bull:** uprates and new-build support mean this deal adds megawatts to the grid rather than only re-contracting existing ones — answering the 'AI steals existing clean power' critique. **Bear:** everything material (price, tenor, escalators) is confidential, so the >2,600MW headline cannot be converted into a revenue or cost estimate by outsiders.
